arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Prowess{/c} now lasts {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds and its bonuses are increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c}. While you have {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} stacks of {c_important}Prowess{/c}, your {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} is overfilled by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} and your {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"|%x|]{/c} increased damage per {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} you have.
